purpose: External research-tool adapters used by SciXZ journal-selection and citation-verification routes
policy: External sites are advisory evidence sources, but both adapters are mandatory evidence branches for SciXZ journal-selection and citation-management routes. They never replace the canonical installed Skill or authoritative verification source.

mandatory_route_groups.completion_rule: Both tools must be invoked and produce an auditable result before the final ranked journal cascade is published.
Both tools must be invoked for candidate discovery/triage before the final reference audit is published.
When reference proofreading is in scope, both tools are required; a preflight cannot be marked ready without both run records.

tools.name: JANE (Journal/Author Name Estimator)
tools.required_artifact: documented query URL plus captured response or normalized result record
tools.fallback_policy: diagnostics-only; no final journal ranking or citation-proofreading conclusion without a completed JANE run

input_policy.default: send the minimum de-identified text needed for similarity search

evidence_limits: JANE ranks by similarity to PubMed records and is not an acceptance predictor
the service may include journals from PubMed that require further quality screening
the service warns that predatory journals can appear; MEDLINE and DOAJ tags are signals, not a complete whitelist
the FAQ states that the data behind JANE is updated monthly
verification: journal homepage and current author guidelines
current indexing status from authoritative sources
current APC and policy facts from the journal or publisher
candidate paper metadata through PubMed/CrossRef before citation use

tools.name: iPubMed (实战医学统计)
tools.required_artifact: browser run record plus exported result, saved page, or user-provided export
tools.fallback_policy: diagnostics-only; no final journal ranking or citation-proofreading conclusion without a completed iPubMed run

input_policy.default: use browser-assisted input or exported results; never place third-party API keys in SciXZ manifests

evidence_limits: the public page exposes a dynamic Shiny interface rather than a documented stable API
IF, APC, indexing and search results are time-sensitive and must be dated and rechecked
title-level suspicious-reference results are triage signals, not misconduct or fabrication verdicts
download and non-OA retrieval must respect publisher, copyright and institutional access rules
verification: journal homepage and current author guidelines
current journal metrics and APC through authoritative sources
reference identifiers through PubMed/CrossRef and the cited source
retraction/preprint status through authoritative bibliographic records
